_description: Validation rules, business logic, and edge cases discovered from tickets

rules.rule: During registration, auto-assign an unused Shoppix.me email from ActiveSubmissionEmailSelect pool. Skip emails claimed by concurrent registrations.
Do NOT add 50 tokens for auto-assigned Shoppix.me email addresses.
Schedule ActiveSubmission notification message for 1pm the next day in the configured timezone, accounting for DST.
Facebook registrations set IsFirstEmailConfirmed=true and skip confirmation email.
Apple registrations set IsFirstEmailConfirmed=true, AppleId, IsApplePrivateEmail, and skip confirmation email.
If ActiveSubmission email assignment throws an exception, registration still succeeds. Exception is logged.
createuserprofile service bus message is only sent if AppUser was successfully persisted (DoesAppUserIdExist check).
Selecting a voucher row opens the matching voucher detail page.
Voucher list should present redeemed vouchers in a consistent order based on redemption date, newest first.
Voucher details must show the registered Shoppix email address associated with the reward.
The copy icon must copy the displayed order reference value.
Go to my voucher is shown only for vouchers that support direct voucher access, such as Amazon.co.uk in the screenshots.
If the vouchers API fails, the screen should fail gracefully and allow recovery or retry.

Notifications must use category-specific icons: Shelf=notifications_shelf, Referrals=notifications_referral, Reminder=notifications_reminder, Warning=notifications_warning, Voucher=notifications_voucher.
CTA button title is sourced from Column N (CTA) in the notification configuration spreadsheet.
Dynamic variables in notification text must be replaced with actual user-specific values at delivery time.
When user has no notifications, show a dedicated empty state UI instead of a blank screen.
When notification loading fails, show an error state UI with a retry option.
NEW_SURVEYS_AVAILABLE must use 'a few minutes' instead of {minutes} variable because survey teams don't fill in duration data reliably.
RECEIPT_MISMATCH_WITH_ANOTHERUSER and MULTIPLE_RECEIPT_MATCH must have no CTA because receipt is never created.
DUPLICATE_RECEIPT_REMINDER CTA changes from 'See Receipt' to 'Learn More' with Help Centre navigation.
ACTIVESUBMISSONREMINDER_UNRECOGNISED CTA 'View details' is removed and navigation changes to GENERAL_REMINDER_REFERRALS.
Per RC review: ERECEIPT_APPROVED_AFTER_REWORK and RECEIPT_CHALLENGE_APPROVED CTAs should be 'See receipt' navigating to the approved receipt.
TIME_LIMIT_EXCEED_REMINDER, VALID_RECEIPT_REMINDER, and SCRATCHCARD_AWARDED gain Lock Screen placement.
TWO_WEEKS_INACTIVITY_WARNING triggers weekly at 5 PM UTC Thursday for live users with no receipt in 14 days but receipt in last 90 days.
WEEKLY_INACTIVITY_WARNING triggers at 5 PM UTC Sunday for users with approved receipt in 14 days but not in 7 days.
FINAL_SURVEY_COMPLETION_REMINDER triggers daily at 3 PM UTC for surveys expiring within 1 day.
SURVEY_COMPLETION_REMINDER triggers daily at 3:30 PM UTC for surveys expiring within 3 days.
ACTIVE_ENGAGEMENT_NOTIFICATION triggers 1st of every month at 10 AM UTC for users with approved forwarded e-receipts last month.
Accounts created with Facebook sign-in must support both deactivation and deletion flows.
The absence of a local password must not block account deactivation or deletion for Facebook-created accounts.
Repeated deactivation or deletion actions must be handled gracefully without crashing or corrupting state.
A deleted account must not be usable for subsequent sign-in or return an active profile on any device.
Automatic assignment of a Shoppix.me email must not grant a 50-token reward.
The user's token balance must not increase by 50 tokens because of Shoppix.me email assignment.
No transaction history entry should be created for the removed 50-token reward.
No push, in-app, email, or similar reward notification should be generated for the removed reward.
Other eligible reward flows must continue to work normally.
For social-login users, the deactivate/delete confirmation must not fall back to a password-only identity check.
Account deletion must dispatch its downstream service bus message cleanly without leaving items in the dead-letter queue.
Deactivate/delete actions must not leave the account in a half-completed state if the network drops mid-request.
The Launch button is enabled only when survey status is Created or UserListRefreshed.
The Launch button is disabled for every other survey status, including terminal or in-progress states.
Token regeneration for already logged-in users is not part of this ticket's scope.
Survey creation requires a unique Tivian survey ID; duplicates must be rejected.
The Tivian survey ID must pass validation before survey details can be saved.
Token value and expiry date/time are required inputs for creating a survey.
The survey should be refreshed before launch so the latest survey data is available.
Users should be refreshed before launching the survey so the app receives the updated survey audience.
The Launch Survey button is enabled only when the survey status is Created or UserListRefreshed.
After successful launch, the survey must be reflected in the Shoppix app.
Token regeneration for already-logged-in users is not part of this ticket.
The bell icon is visible in the app header for logged-in users on screens where it is defined.
The bell icon badge reflects the current unread notification count.
Reading unread notifications must clear or decrement the bell icon badge.
Tapping the bell icon opens the Notification Centre screen.
Unread counts above the display limit are shown as a capped indicator such as 99+.
Bell icon unread badge count must persist across app kill and relaunch.
Push notifications received while the app is in background must update the bell icon unread badge on next foreground.
Tapping an individual notification marks only that notification as read and decrements the unread count accordingly.
Notification cards are ordered newest first by timestamp.
Notification card hides the CTA button when no CTA is configured.
Notification card uses a safe fallback icon when the category is unmapped.
Unread notification cards display a teal border around the card and a red dot on the top-right of the category icon.
Scratch-related CTAs use yellow buttons; standard action CTAs (Start now, View voucher) use dark blue.
Category icons: scratchcard = yellow gift/ribbon, survey = clipboard, voucher = gift box, retailer linking = chain link, active submission = Shoppix S mark.
Recent notifications show DD/MM/YYYY; older ones use relative format like 'X days ago'; OS tray uses 'Just now', 'X minutes ago'.
Empty/error state on Notification Centre is minimal: a centered refresh icon that reloads when tapped.
Bottom app navigation is not shown on the Notification Centre screen.
Notification body must use '1 minute' (singular) when duration equals 1; current 'It only takes 1 minutes' is a defect.
Empty state must render the yellow bell illustration with 'No notifications yet' heading and a full-width 'Start snapping' CTA that opens the receipt snap flow.
Error state must render the bell + question mark illustration with 'Something went wrong' heading and a full-width 'Try again' CTA that retries loading.

Category icon backgrounds map to distinct colors: Rewards purple, Reminder cyan, Survey purple, Warning light blue with blue exclamation, Referral green, Shelf purple, Voucher orange, Scratchcard yellow, E-receipts purple, Nulink orange, Receipt approved green.
Dynamic placeholders like {tokens}, {minutes}, {days}, {N}, {email} must be replaced at runtime; raw curly-brace placeholders must never be shown to end users.
Scratchcard notification title and body must respect singular vs plural: 'a scratchcard' / 'Scratch your card' for 1; '2 scratchcards' / 'Scratch your cards' for 2+.
Design placeholder strings such as 'Referral title', 'Need to check', or 'No text' must not be shipped to production.
